stem.text: Which diagram correctly represents part of a sieve tube element?

A.alt: Diagram of a tube-shaped cell with a sieve plate across the lower part; labels: lignified cell wall, empty lumen, sieve plate.

B.alt: Diagram of a tube-shaped cell with a sieve plate across the lower part and an oval nucleus; labels: dense cytoplasm, nucleus, sieve plate.

C.alt: Diagram of a tube-shaped cell with a sieve plate and a rounded vacuole at the top; labels: tonoplast, vacuole, sieve plate.

D.alt: Diagram of a tube-shaped cell with a sieve plate across the lower part and a thin layer of cytoplasm along the wall; labels: thin layer of cytoplasm, cellulose cell wall, sieve plate.
